EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows a distinct S–H stretch at 2508 cm⁻¹ and an S–H bend at 1203 cm⁻¹ (GFQ-005), uniquely indicating a thiol/thiothioamide; only candidate 3 (CNC(=S)S) contains an SH group. The NH-related band at 935 cm⁻¹ (GFQ-002) and NH/CH stretches near 3200–3317 and 2837–2988 cm⁻¹ (GFQ-002, GFQ-003) match its NH and aliphatic CH groups. Additional bands around 1221–1256 cm⁻¹ are consistent with a thioamide C=S region. Other candidates lack SH and do not explain the 2508/1203 cm⁻¹ features.
